raw_http_text: {"id":"2ebc1e56-8bb3-4f57-87d6-be2881556396_2srdz2g3z7taernf9c_9411cda254f246668a278831ba5e4bcd","choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"{\"schema_version\":\"1.0\",\"packet_id\":\"CAND_TOPIC_01_R2_V1\",\"mode\":\"organized_reflection\",\"sentences\":[{\"text\":\"人类活动使大气二氧化碳增加，溶入海洋的二氧化碳也随之增加，但证据未给出某一年吸收的比例、速度或上限。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E04\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"海洋酸化指氢离子浓度上升、pH下降的方向，海水平均仍呈碱性却可继续酸化，两者并不矛盾。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E05\"],\"kind\":\"limitation\"},{\"text\":\"2016年植被变绿研究区分观测与归因，叶面积增加的检出依赖数据，各驱动因素作用需借助模型判断。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"在未给出某一年吸收比例、速度或上限的条件下，仅凭大气与海洋吸收的联系，能否推断海洋可持续完全抵消排放？\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"question\"}]}","role":"assistant","tool_calls":null}}],"created":1794399761,"model":"mimo-v2.6-flash","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":223,"prompt_tokens":1695,"total_tokens":1918,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":1664}}}
